dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high-curvature spline that transitions sharply into a horizontal posterior ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrow pixel radius with a rounded classification, featuring multiple small-scale irregular notches along the posterior-superior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, linear ascending margin at approximately a 55-degree angle relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.45:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct notches and indentations along the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; prominent cluster of white, circular punctate lesions localized on the lower posterior dorsal flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique serrated profile of the trailing edge and specific spatial distribution of white cutaneous marks on the posterior body segment.
